name: Scarlet Lotus Assassin
description: A figure in black and crimson who has been following you for longer than you realise. A curved red-lacquered short-blade in each hand; a veil of dark red silk across the lower face. They do not speak: that is a courtesy they reserve for comrades.
ambush_text: A crimson silk scarf flutters from a crow-perch as you pass. There is no bird.

name: Scarlet Lotus Hunter
description: A heavyset woman in a red leather cuirass worked with lotus-scale plates, a single long steel hook in each hand. A contract sits folded in her sash; the corner that protrudes bears an azure wax seal, defaced.
ambush_text: The crowd at the market parts around a tall figure who has been reading your back for an hour. The contract in her sash bears a seal you recognise.

name: Blood-Sworn Wretch
description: A cultivator the Pavilion made and then forgot — eyes the colour of candle-wax, forearms scored with old self-cuttings that still weep faintly. They fight without strategy, because pain is not a thing they can feel any more.

name: Scarlet Pavilion Guardian
description: A veteran of the red-petal robes — broader than any outer disciple, and calmer. A pair of lotus-hilted hook-swords rest easily at the waist. The eyes are not cruel. That, somehow, is worse.
ambush_text: The gallery darkens. A guardian steps between you and the bridge, not drawing yet — not having to.
